messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing.metering.alert - token_count delta > 18% detected in eu-west-1 (trace 0x7f3a). Please acknowledge: https://ops.redwood/incident/1738881111
oncall-sre: Acked. I'm on it. Checking consumer lag and emitter heartbeats.
billing-eng: Noted. Our counters show ingest gaps 02:10-02:30 UTC; overflagging ramped at ~02:18.
oncall-sre: Topology: emitter-service -> kafka -> billing-aggregator. Consumer lag ~120k msgs on billing-aggregator partition 4. Restarting consumer group now.
data-platform: Restarted consumer group billing-agg-cg on eu1. Offsets committed at 124210. Lag dropping -> ~8k.
billing-eng: We should mute auto-overage alerts while backlog drains to avoid noisy customer emails. Runbook: /runbook mute_overage_alerts
mary-cs: FYI CS: we've got a ticket — customer reported overage email at 02:25 in EU. Any confirmation on charges?
billing-eng: No invoices run yet. Invoice job runs at 03:00. We see orphan overage flags in the staging tally; recommend holding invoice-run or applying a guard to ignore flags older than 180s if from backlog.
oncall-sre: Applying temporary mitigation: set `metering.ignore_stale_emits=true` for 10m. Patch pushed via deploy-bot. Creating shadow tally snapshots for affected accounts.
oncall-sre: Logs:
```
[02:34:12] consumer restart OK
[02:34:45] lag=8200 -> 1200
[02:35:30] emitter-heartbeat: delayed by 320s
```

billing-eng: Quick recon run: `SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE ingested_at BETWEEN '2026-03-20 02:10' AND '2026-03-20 02:40' AND region='eu-west-1';` result: 1,210,312 (expected ~1,450,982) — delta ~16%.
oncall-sre: Bridge created: zoom.us/j/123456789 (ops bridge). Tagging @pagerduty.
mary-cs: Drafting customer note: "Delayed usage reports may cause transient overage notifications. No charges applied yet. We're investigating." Posting to #customer-notices for review.
billing-eng: Agreed. If invoice-run executes before full reconciliation, we'll prepare manual compensation credits. I'll own billing follow-up and postmortem.
data-platform: Consumer lag cleared at 02:41. Final offsets caught up; kinesis/kafka throughput normalized.
oncall-sre: Confirming: overage alert muting ended at 02:50, invoices remain blocked until 03:15 for safety.
mary-cs: CS update: only one customer ticket opened, they acknowledged the notice and appreciated the quick update :thumbsup:. No immediate escalations.
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated; monitoring. Please create postmortem when stable.
alex: Handoff to next oncall. I'll own follow-ups: add an emitter-heartbeat alert (early warning) and an invoice-run guard to prevent invoice jobs when backlog > X. Notes in ops/incident-1738881111.
oncall-sre: Handoff accepted by alex. Bridge closed. Leaving monitoring for next 30m then demobilize
